value.rationale: Characteristic path length and global efficiency are standard global integration measures with different averaging of the same shortest-path data. The sharp boundary shows the first order at which they can make opposite decisions even after controlling vertex count, edge count, and—in the witness—degree multiset. That isolates distance-distribution shape as the cause and provides a compact reproducibility benchmark for network analysis.
